title: Bland-Altman limits of agreement for method comparison
summary: The bias between two measurement methods and the 95% limits of agreement, each with an interval, and a check for proportional bias.

sizing._why: Method-comparison sample size is set by the precision wanted for the limits of agreement (Lu et al. 2016); no catalog form takes it.

pinned_defaults: Differences B - A; bias with a t interval; limits bias +/- 1.96 SD with Bland and Altman's (1999) approximate intervals, SE sqrt(3 s^2 / n) and t on n - 1 df.
Proportional bias: slope of the differences regressed on the means.
_correlation: The methods correlate at 0.96 while B reads 2.5 higher and individual differences range from -6.9 to 11.8: correlation is not agreement.
